gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-malayalam: Tall, glowing, stamped-metal lowercase: that's Neon. Anek Malayalam, a sans-serif whose curves stop just short of closing, carries a full page of text smoothly, with its x-height sitting close to the capitals.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-odia: Vibrant and tube-bright, Neon draws round letters like bent wire, each stroke holding a single width from end to end. Anek Odia keeps pages of text flowing, its rounds left unlatched like hooks.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls and curves that look half unwrapped beneath Neon's tall, monoweight lettering. Its best trick is glowing line work set against soft, open rounds.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anek-telugu: Neon draws tall, glowing letters with a rounded-nib look, no swelling anywhere along each stroke. Anek Telugu, a sans-serif of wide, tall bowls, handles the steady reading while Neon grabs the eye.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-anuphan: Big round bowls and clear gaps in every curve give the text a gentle, open feel under Neon's glow. Anuphan lets paragraphs run on without tiring the eye, plain sans letters that never crowd.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-arimo: Neutral to its core, Arimo is a sans-serif with a tall mean line and open terminals in rounded letters. And Neon, whose bowls match its stems, would be happiest given a generous size.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-armata: Neon is glass-tube lettering, hollow and constant in thickness, with tall stamped-metal lowercase. And it earns its keep big and brief, while Armata, a sans-serif with spacious gaps, fills in the text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-athiti: Neon glows with tall stamped-metal lowercase and generous spacing between every glyph. Athiti, a sans-serif with see-through s shapes and a high mean line, gives that glow somewhere calm to land.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Glowing, tall, and cut from a single, unbroken line width. Neon owns the loud moments, while Atkinson Hyperlegible, with clipped capitals and wide-set s terminals, handles the quiet reading.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters wide, stencil-bridge style. Neon's monoline tubes carry the glow up top, tall and unbroken, while the plain sans text below breathes into the white space.
